say:0:1560204001:0.text: Magister, I see a sleeping manafleur, and a chest!
say:0:1560204001:0.source_cn: 主人！那边的花没有毒雾，旁边还有个宝箱！
say:0:1560204001:0.male: Magister, I see a sleeping manafleur, and a chest!
say:0:1560204001:0.female: Magister, I see a sleeping manafleur, and a chest!

say:1:1560204002:0.text: Quick, let's open the chest before it wakes up!
say:1:1560204002:0.source_cn: 趁花粉还没释放，我们去看看宝箱里有什么吧！
